zoe: Heads-up: new users hitting 429s during sample app onboarding. Prefetch=5 fires parallel page fetches and token refresh sometimes fails mid-run, leading to client circuit open.

mike: Which SDK/version?

zoe: node-sdk 0.13.0, defaults: PREFETCH=5, CONCURRENCY=6, REFRESH_BEFORE=15s.

harry: Known parity gap: node retry has no jitter right now. When prefetch does N parallel calls, retries align and amplify.

zoe: Quick repro log: "2026-03-22T09:01:02Z WARN 429 /chat.generate" then "2026-03-22T09:01:03Z INFO refresh start" then "2026-03-22T09:01:04Z ERROR refresh failed 502" then circuit open.

mike: Short fixes: lower sample defaults to PREFETCH=2 + CONCURRENCY=2; add jitter in node retry; make prefill sequential by default in onboarding flow. Also add idempotency for page ids.

harry: I'll PR jitter + update sample defaults. Also add telemetry event onboard.prefill.failure so we can alert.

ops-bot: Canary deploy queued for sample-node v0.5.0 at 2026-03-22T14:30Z.

zoe: Thanks! I'll add a one-line troubleshooting hint in README in the meantime.
